events.evidence: Russian forces launch a ballistic missile attack on two buses in the city of Kramatorsk in Ukraine, killing at least 30 people
U.S. president Donald Trump says that the U.S. military will not attack Iran before the midterm elections next month
The Taiwanese finance ministry reports that exports reached a record US$87.2 billion in September
